title: The best solar powered pool skimmers
seo_title: Best Solar Powered Pool Skimmers — Four Compared
meta_description: The four best-selling solar pool skimmers on Amazon compared: runtime claims, basket size, sensors and apps, and what each listing does not tell you.
standfirst: A solar pool skimmer takes leaves off the surface before they sink, and does nothing else. These four are the best sellers on Amazon US, compared on the claims that matter and on what each maker leaves out.

picks.why: The only one of the four with a manufacturer's product page and manual to read: a stated one-year warranty, a 200 micron basket, 3.5 hours on the adapter and 5 to 6 on the sun. Betta's 30 hour figure is a claim, but it sits among numbers you can check.
picks.not_for: Anyone who wants an app or edge following, or a pool in permanent shade.
pros: A manufacturer page and manual you can read
3.5 hours on the adapter, 5 to 6 in the sun
Twin salt chlorine tolerant motors, Betta says
cons: The 30 hour runtime is Betta's own figure
Skims the surface only, never the floor

picks.why: Aiper's listing is the most specific about how the machine stays out of trouble: two dToF sensors for walls and corners, and adjustable anti-stranding columns for steps. It also has the 35 hour battery figure, which is a claim.
picks.not_for: Anyone who needs a published basket volume or warranty term before buying; the listing gives neither.

Adjustable columns to stop it stranding on steps
150 micron filter with a leak-proof baffle, Aiper says
cons: Basket volume and warranty are not published
The 35 hour battery is Aiper's own figure
Adapter charge time is not stated

picks.why: A 9 litre basket, the largest volume any of the four states, behind a covered intake Beatbot says keeps debris in when the machine reverses. For a pool that sheds, fewer trips to empty it is the point.
picks.not_for: Anyone who needs a stated runtime in hours; the listing gives none.

faq.q: Does a solar pool skimmer work on cloudy days?
faq.a: It works from its battery, and the battery is refilled by the panel or, on all four, by a wall adapter. Every maker here claims round-the-clock cleaning, and none of the figures is ours. How long a machine runs after several grey days is the number to look for in owner reviews.

faq.q: Do I still need a robotic pool cleaner if I have a skimmer?
faq.a: Yes, if the floor or walls get dirty. A skimmer collects what floats and nothing else. It is a good partner for a floor robot because debris caught at the surface never sinks.

faq.q: Are solar pool skimmers safe in a saltwater pool?
faq.a: Two of these four say something about salt: the Betta SE Plus describes salt chlorine tolerant motors and the Beatbot iSkim listing says saltwater-safe. The Aiper and BRINBO listings we read do not say, so check before using one in a salt pool.

faq.q: How do you get a floating skimmer out of the pool?
faq.a: Some park themselves. Beatbot says the iSkim parks after cleaning or on one tap in its app, and the BRINBO app shows a park button. The Betta SE Plus runs automatically or from a remote. Otherwise it is a pole or a hand.
